rows.30:69cc:
I see...
I had a favor to ask of you, kind as you are...
There was something I wanted you to promise me.
I wanted you to break the curse I'm about to tell you about.
But you're someone who can't take other people's advice, aren't you?{p}
rows.30:6ff0:
He decided to just keep going.
Considering how far he had already walked, going forward should get him home sooner than turning back.
Stifling the bad feeling spreading deep in his chest, he kept walking.
............He heard something.
Startled, he froze in his tracks.{p}
rows.30:75f0:
At that very moment.
She turned around, and when he saw her, he was so shocked his breath stopped.{p}
rows.30:9dbc:
Well?
Does it hurt?
It must hurt.
She means to kill you, after all.
Listen.
You can hear it, can't you?
Her voice.
Are you suffering?
Can't you breathe?{p}
rows.30:a408:
Forward, no matter what.
She came after you.
From behind you came a strange voice, like the chirring of insects.
A shrill voice, like metal grinding against metal.
It was her scream.
You ran for your life.
You tried to get away from her.
But her screaming didn't stop.
She's coming after you.
She's coming after you.
She's coming after you.
.........................................................................................................................................................She's coming after you...
This hallway goes on forever.
No matter how far you run, you can't escape.
You can't hide, either.
You can't catch a ride, either.
There's nothing but the hallway.
There's nowhere to run.
Heh heh...
She chased you.
On and on.
On and on.
On and on.
Even though a moment ago she said her leg hurt.
No matter how fast you run, she keeps coming.
You can hear her scream...
Right in your ear.
Hot breath blows on you.
Blows on the nape of your neck.{p}
